title: Contract upgrade with discount
content: Month-to-month high-risk customers: offer 25-35% discount for 6 months when switching to a one-year contract. Add free TechSupport if missing.

title: Fiber quality recovery
content: Fiber optic customers with high bills: up to 1-2 free months plus OnlineSecurity bundle. Keep total bonus value below $500 unless approved by a manager.

title: Loyalty bonus
content: Medium-risk customers: 10-20% discount for 3 months or one free month of streaming bundle. Never exceed 20% discount.

title: Light-touch retention
content: Low-risk customers: small gesture only — 5-10% discount for 1-2 months or a free add-on (OnlineBackup). Discounts above 20% are forbidden.

title: Escalation policy
content: Any free period longer than 3 months or total bonus value above $500 requires manual review by a retention manager.
